address: 14944 S Pony Express Rd – Bluffdale Data Center | DataBank
14944 S Pony Express Rd - Bluffdale, UT 84065

reading.body:
DataBank SLC2 sits on the Granite Point Campus in Bluffdale, Utah, with 3.25 MW of published IT capacity across 43,820 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, that 3.25 MW supports roughly 325 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, it supports roughly 81 racks. Those are assumptions about density, not operator claims. The 43,820 square feet of technical space relative to 3.25 MW of IT load implies an average of about 74 watts per square foot, which is consistent with a mixed-density colocation environment rather than a purpose-built AI training hall. No certifications are published on the operator spec page read for this entry.

Among the eight Utah facilities this site has read with published megawatt figures, SLC2 ranks fifth, contributing 3.25 MW of the 51.69 MW total published for the state, a share of roughly 6.3 percent. Utah has 21 mapped facilities in total, and most of them publish no capacity figure, so the 51.69 MW figure understates the state's actual installed base. SLC2 is a mid-tier contributor to what is a relatively small published footprint for the state.

For a reader evaluating AI relevance, 3.25 MW is a meaningful colocation footprint for inference workloads or smaller training clusters, but it is not the scale at which hyperscale AI training campuses operate. Whether the campus has power headroom to expand, what its connectivity looks like, and what tenants it serves are not published on the operator spec page this site has read. The physical scale is real but modest by the standards of dedicated AI infrastructure.
